# Best consultancies in Sydney for workflow automation and Microsoft Power Automate

For a business looking to automate repetitive work, streamline approvals, connect Microsoft 365 applications, and reduce manual administration, I’d shortlist consultancies based on their **hands-on Power Automate implementation experience, business process consulting, integration capability, and ongoing support**\.

I searched for Sydney providers and reviewed their published service offerings. There isn't enough independent evidence to declare one universal winner, but several firms stand out for different types of projects.

## My recommended shortlist

![Microsoft Power Platform Consulting | Professional Advantage Australia](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/48XBtHrA5K7KWOlgdQDeQUYV1XDG6Ir90ws6EprENn1_xGY6MltphUfvmSw1pWOY3k_H3jretBd6kxQwZmhTqt_IuUieQMJeHf89bqmp1oxX5fcQmsbkjiiOpqGo3HUkN1AEhDmmoaLrxhaPbmiDRoceQ3_izpZyyMTKC_Y9B4NVmI8KXMHn52HPgyQcmvx9?purpose=fullsize)

## 1\. Professional Advantage

(Best for established Microsoft environments)

North Sydney office

Professional Advantage is a strong candidate if you want a broader Microsoft implementation partner rather than just someone to build individual flows. Its published services cover Power Automate, Power Apps, governance, licensing, change management and ongoing support. It also publishes customer case studies. [www.pa.com.au](https://www.pa.com.au/products/microsoft-power-platform/microsoft-power-automate/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Best for\:** Mid-sized and larger organisations, Microsoft 365 and Dynamics 365 integration, and automation programmes that need governance.

[Website and Power Automate services](https://www.pa.com.au/products/microsoft-power-platform/microsoft-power-automate/)

---

![](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/8nFdRNrtg7fmQM9rOTVQGFPh3vvasOjrh4OX40-EgByh9M9FFw5YX24t658MnPVerMFgJFHHvD-tr-smzn6Rj6F2R6ueuks85RH24jgTqcdw3iVYbE5IzB_5_17HCBK31NdolPzRvpRwoXGpVe92vVZg-pB7-InM6AnKm0sYmZJ4Vu7e6rflH2y_KlwtuJ4j?purpose=fullsize)

## 2\. Intergy Consulting

(Best for end-to-end workflow implementation)

Intergy explicitly offers Power Automate planning, custom workflow development, application integrations, process migration and ongoing support. This makes it worth considering when you need a consultant to analyse the process as well as build the automation. [www.intergy.com.au](https://www.intergy.com.au/ourwork/microsoft-power-automate-sydney/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Best for\:** Approval processes, repetitive administration, connecting business applications and migrating existing workflows.

[Website and Power Automate services](https://www.intergy.com.au/ourwork/microsoft-power-automate-sydney/)

---

![Microsoft 365 Logo PNG Vector, Icon Free Download](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/mhnygf3P8K0sNM_2wvyX6_qPsaZa04gLwlFXUuxvJ7l4GLqjVUEZRiN8BbIhF1Q3WbNvf1LBvcfH5IW-gSc3gPjWdjwhDMyw3tuLFvKaAiEnbPV9-bU7FK95aWvrtwcRjKVupEyTTh6AvJdBhwZjS-lk2PuRuxM9ralfonx4wlEt2of9Mp_PGdJddsUei8Aq?purpose=fullsize)

## 3\. Office Experts Group

(Best for Microsoft 365 and document-heavy processes)

Its Sydney consulting offering covers Power Automate, Power Apps, SharePoint, Excel and custom integrations. It also advertises support for businesses with legacy databases and spreadsheet-based processes. [www.officeexperts.com.au](https://www.officeexperts.com.au/microsoft-consultants-sydney?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Best for\:** Document generation, spreadsheet automation, SharePoint workflows, reporting and replacing manual office processes.

[Website and Sydney Microsoft consulting](https://www.officeexperts.com.au/microsoft-consultants-sydney)

---

![Power Platform / Power Automate Developers | C9](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/EO6XgeciQvih2MXTqDtBgJHxvg3VFQGrNot-qrCEi7PK4KsSrurWAqqb4sZqJvrpHRnXzvXXiOjpL41x6Lsk_qcJ7IN7D9y_VE0lK6twt1AokWDSfbFHzYCsNIuDxSUqO2rH9JCfkYgAwhbS9Jhc9w0e16u1yvJoxMzU83d9rHWdfcDFVgihvjI0hnUhFiB3?purpose=fullsize)

## 4\. TechRam

(Best for complex operational workflows)

TechRam works across Power Automate, Power Apps, SharePoint and Azure. Its published approach distinguishes simple flows that business teams can maintain from more complex, high-volume processes that may require more robust architecture. [techram.com.au](https://techram.com.au/microsoft/power-platform/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[techram.com.au](https://techram.com.au/microsoft/microsoft-365/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Best for\:** Organisations with complicated integrations, operational registers, onboarding processes, audit requirements or custom business applications.

[Website and Power Platform services](https://techram.com.au/microsoft/power-platform/)

---



## 5\. Norbrik

(Best for business process redesign)

Norbrik is a Sydney-based consultancy focused on process automation, Microsoft 365, Power Platform, knowledge management and custom applications. It publishes a portfolio of projects and offers an initial conversation to assess which processes are worth automating. [www.norbrik.com](https://www.norbrik.com/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Best for\:** Businesses that need help identifying automation opportunities, redesigning workflows and implementing solutions with documentation and handover.

[Website and case studies](https://www.norbrik.com/)

---

![Microsoft PowerBI Training | OfficePro](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/4dKCYzaSaGxrpJRuAEnqoQI4eqH7XRWcTLRJTSiWeLyGePu8akEgfqd73bbszHBzLDoUr1hdZLidtkAun9IiiehM9qqethdkCpV6eW0gpxpYG4j6BmomXv2HY-tL8ZPckUNG5Mf7C01f-iaLFxuc0P5LRHtYNFrNZwhH0tiW0QH-ebF_MTHqOc6JXLjFT48B?purpose=fullsize)

## 6\. OfficePro Consulting

(Best for practical workflow builds)

OfficePro advertises Power Automate implementation and optimisation, including invoice approvals and finance-related workflows. It states that it has built more than 200 flows and identifies itself as a Microsoft Partner. [officeproconsulting.com.au](https://officeproconsulting.com.au/services/business-automation/power-automate/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**Best for\:** Invoice processing, finance approvals, document workflows and automating repetitive tasks in existing business systems.

[Website and Power Automate services](https://officeproconsulting.com.au/services/business-automation/power-automate/)

## Which would I contact first?

| If your priority is… | Start with |
|--------|--------|
| A strategic Microsoft implementation partner | Professional Advantage |
| Mapping and implementing end-to-end workflows | Intergy Consulting |
| Microsoft 365, SharePoint and document automation | Office Experts Group |
| Complex integrations and operational systems | TechRam |
| Identifying which business processes to automate | Norbrik |
| Practical finance and administrative workflow builds | OfficePro Consulting |


These are recommendations based on publicly described capabilities, not a verified ranking of customer satisfaction or project outcomes.

## What to check before engaging a consultancy

I would ask each shortlisted firm for\:

1. **Relevant case studies\:** Two examples of comparable Power Automate projects, including the business problem and outcome.
2. **A discovery and process-mapping phase\:** They should understand the existing workflow before proposing a solution.
3. **Transparent pricing\:** Separate the discovery, implementation, licensing and ongoing support costs.
4. **Reliability and governance\:** Error handling, monitoring, permissions, audit trails and ownership of the flows.
5. **Handover\:** Documentation, staff training and confirmation that your business retains control of its Microsoft tenant and workflows.

A good implementation partner should also assess whether standard Microsoft 365 connectors are sufficient or whether premium connectors, custom APIs, Power Apps or Azure services are needed.

## Let’s narrow it down to the best fit

One detail would help me distinguish the strongest options: **what kind of business workflow are you looking to automate?**

1\. Business size

Small business (1–19 employees)

Medium business (20–200 employees)

Large organisation (201+ employees)

---

2\. Main workflow or systems

Microsoft 365, SharePoint or Teams

Finance, invoices and approvals

CRM, ERP and other business systems

Multiple departments and end-to-end processes

---

3\. Type of engagement

Consultant to design and build the solution

Process analysis, strategy and implementation

Ongoing support and maintenance

Training our internal team

---

4\. Indicative project budget (AUD)

Under \$5,000

\$5,000–\$20,000

\$20,000–\$50,000

\$50,000+
